question: Shiva get his college degree 30 years ago. If the present age of the Shiva is thrice to the age at which he got his degree, then find the Shiva age after 30 years from now.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Age at degree to Present age = 1 : 3

Difference in ratio parts = 3 − 1 = 2 units.

2 units = 30 years ⇒ 1 unit = 15 years.

Present age = 3 units = 45 years.

Age after 30 years from now = 45 + 30 = 75 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 75 years.**
